name: Request for Team Attendance Summary
goal: User asks for their team's attendance summary in Hinglish.
constraints: Bot should provide attendance stats for the team.

phases.description: User says 'Mere team ka June attendance summary batao'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides attendance summary for Sales team for June 2024.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
